strongest_angle: Explore the newly published and deciphered first travel diary of Harry Houdini spanning 1897 to 1899, uncovering his early struggles in dime-store vaudeville from the collection of Dr. Bruce Averbook and annotated by John Cox.

key_facts.fact: Author John Cox announced the publication of Escaping Obscurity: The Travel Diary of Harry Houdini, 1897-1899, which reproduces every page of Harry Houdini's first travel diary from the collection of Dr. Bruce Averbook.

National Geographic writer Nina Strochlic reported that Harry Houdini's little red book contains recently deciphered notes charting his rise as a performer and the key role of his wife, Bess, in turning his act into international stardom.

Collector Dr. Bruce Averbook noted that Escaping Obscurity: The Travel Diary of Harry Houdini, 1897-1899 presents the earliest known diary of Harry Houdini from his collection, which has never been made public before in its entirety.
